text: Does what Madam Bellinsky said come true?
zh: 贝林斯基太太说的话应验了吗？
zh_hant: 貝林斯基太太說的話應驗了嗎？

text: At a village fair, I decided to visit a fortune-teller called
zh: 在一个乡村集市上，我决定去拜访一位算命人
zh_hant: 在一個鄉村集市上，我決定去拜訪一位算命人

text: Madam Bellinsky.
I went into her tent and she told me to sit down.
zh: 我走进她的帐篷，她让我坐下。
zh_hant: 我走進她的帳篷，她讓我坐下。

text: After I had given her some money,
she looked into a crystal ball and said:
'A relation of yours is coming to see you.
She will be arriving this evening and intends to stay for a few days.
The moment you leave this tent, you will get a big surprise.
zh: 你一离开这个帐篷，就会有一个大惊喜。
zh_hant: 你一離開這個帳篷，就會有一個大驚喜。

text: A woman you know well will rush towards you.
zh: 一个你熟悉的女人会朝你冲过来。
zh_hant: 一個你熟悉的女人會朝你衝過來。

text: She will speak to you and then she will lead you away from this place.
zh: 她会跟你说话，然后把你带离这个地方。
zh_hant: 她會跟你說話，然後把你帶離這個地方。

text: That is all.'
As soon as I went outside,
I forgot all about Madam Bellinsky because my wife hurried towards me.
zh: 就把贝林斯基太太的话全忘了，因为我妻子匆匆向我走来。
zh_hant: 就把貝林斯基太太的話全忘了，因為我妻子匆匆向我走來。

text: 'Where have you been hiding?'
she asked impatiently.
'Your sister will be here in less than an hour
zh: “你妹妹不到一个小时就到了，
zh_hant: “你妹妹不到一個小時就到了，

text: and we must be at the station to meet her.
We are late already.'
As she walked away, I followed her out of the fair.
zh: 她转身走开时，我跟着她离开了集市。
zh_hant: 她轉身走開時，我跟著她離開了集市。
